name: Ba Be National Park
kicker: Limestone forest around the mountain lake
summary: The park is the whole trip: the lake, the Nang, Puong Cave, Dau Dang, and the Tay villages at Pac Ngoi and Bo Lu. Sleep inside it. Go to Cao Bang if Ban Gioc is the point. Decision 83/TTg of 10 November 1992 established it from the former forbidden forest of the lake. No tariff was on the pages read, so the fee is check on arrival.
getThere: Pac Ngoi and Bo Lu are inside the park. Road minutes from Hanoi are check on arrival.

notice.title: No park tariff was found
notice.body: The about page, the locations index, and the biodiversity desk do not print a ticket. Gate hours are check on arrival.

body: You come for the circuit the park holds together: the lake, the Nang, Puong Cave, Dau Dang, and the Tay villages. Decision 83/TTg of 10 November 1992 established it from the former forbidden forest of the lake. The about page says management sat with the Cao Bang People’s Committee from 1992 to 1997, the agriculture ministry until 2003, Bac Kan until 1 July 2025, and the Thai Nguyen People’s Committee after Resolution 202/2025/QH15. A 1995 freshwater-lakes conference in the United States named the lake one of 20 special freshwater lakes to protect. The locations index phrases that as one of the 20 largest natural freshwater lakes in the world. The conference line is the one this page keeps.

Both desks say 10,048 ha and split it differently. The about page, noting the old administrative units, gives strict protection 4,010.70 ha, ecological restoration 5,375.60 ha, admin-service 57.40 ha, and an inner buffer of 604.0 ha, plus an outer buffer of 25,309 ha. The biodiversity desk, in a page first dated 31 December 2023, splits the same 10,048 ha into 3,846 ha strict, 6,162 ha restoration, and 40 ha admin.

Species counts disagree, and they stay as three desks. The park’s 2012 survey counted 909 terrestrial plant species, 316 terrestrial vertebrates (40 mammals, 233 birds, 27 reptiles), 16 amphibians, and about 107 fish from the 2006 nomination dossier. The biodiversity desk counts 1,268 higher plants, 182 orchids, 470 vertebrates, and 106 fish, of which 20 have not been seen since the 1970s. UNESCO’s narrative says over 1,800 living species in a mixed flora-and-fauna sentence.

ASEAN recognition is 2003 on the park about page and 2004 on the biodiversity desk and on UNESCO. Ramsar designation is 2 February 2011 on the park page. UNESCO calls it site 1938, the third Ramsar site in Viet Nam. In 2012 the Prime Minister ranked the lake a special national scenic site, Decision 1419/QĐ-TTg. UNESCO’s tentative list, submitted 31 May 2017, is Ba Be – Na Hang. That is a tentative list, and a 2006 nomination was deferred in 2007.

figures.caption: A forested slope meeting the water, with a peak in the cloud
figures.alt: Forested mountain slope along Ba Be Lake, with a rocky peak in cloud

gettingThere: Pac Ngoi and Bo Lu sit on the lake, inside the park. Cho Ra is the commune on the north edge. The about page puts that north edge at xa Cho Ra, the south at xa Nam Cuong, the east at xa Dong Phuc, and the west at xa Na Hang in Tuyen Quang. UNESCO’s 2017 summary still names five communes in the old Ba Be district: Nam Mau, Khang Ninh, Cao Thuong, Quang Khe, and Cao Tri.

legs.heading: From Pac Ngoi
legs.body: You are already in the park. The morning is the boat from the village landing. A measured walk from the house to a gate was not on the pages read. Those minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: By road. The about page says the park is 250 km northeast of Hanoi. The locations index says about 240 km northeast. UNESCO says 250 km north of Hanoi, and 68 km northwest of Bac Kan city. The minutes are check on arrival.

admissionNote: No park tariff was on the about page, the locations index, or the biodiversity desk. Operator price sheets were not adopted. The fee is check on arrival.
